name: THMY
recent: THMY Holdings Berhad 近期持续获得市场关注，主要围绕 AI 测试需求扩大产能。公司公告多为 EPF 的日常持股变动，另有一项董事在闭门期内的交易意向申报。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收与净利均环比增长。
notable: 公司扩大槟城工厂三倍，以把握 AI 与数据中心需求。
最新季度净利环比增长 39.4% 至 RM6.218 million。
董事在闭门期内申报交易意向。
risks: EPF 在约一个月内多次申报持股变动，股权结构持续变化。
董事在闭门期内申报交易意向，后续交易情况需留意。
earnings: 2026-06-30 季度营收为 RM20.232 million，环比增长 17.1%；净利为 RM6.218 million，环比增长 39.4%；净利率从 25.8% 升至 30.7%。

recent_en: THMY Holdings Berhad has drawn market attention recently, mainly around expanding capacity for AI testing demand. Most announcements are routine EPF shareholding changes, plus one director's intention to deal during the closed period. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) saw both revenue and net profit grow quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: The company tripled its Penang factory to capture AI and data centre demand.
Latest quarter net profit rose 39.4% QoQ to RM6.218 million.
A director filed intention to deal during the closed period.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple shareholding changes over about a month, with ongoing changes in ownership structure.
A director declared intention to deal during the closed period; subsequent transactions should be monitored.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue was RM20.232 million, up 17.1% QoQ; net profit was RM6.218 million, up 39.4% QoQ; net margin rose from 25.8% to 30.7%.
